Title: Jeremiah Taken to Egypt
KeyPersons: Jeremiah; Johanan, Son of Kareah; Baruch
Events: Against Jeremiah's word that they must stay, Johanan and the remnant carry Jeremiah and Baruch down to Egypt, reaching Tahpanhes, where Jeremiah buries stones at Pharaoh's house as a sign that Babylon will conquer Egypt too.
